extDescription.message: Browse any website with your hands, through the webcam. Scroll, pick links and click without touching mouse or keyboard.

grantText.message: Recognition runs in an invisible document, which cannot show Chrome's permission prompt. Allow the camera once in a tab, and it counts for every site.

setLeftHandedSub.message: Your left hand picks and clicks

footer.message: Shortcut $SHORTCUT$. The camera only runs while this is on, and the video never leaves your computer.

hudSearchingHint.message: One hand scrolls, the other picks and clicks

hudPausedHint.message: A closed fist locks everything: open it to carry on

hudClickingHint.message: Hold the finger up for 2 seconds

hudNothingSelectedHint.message: Open that hand to pick a link first

hudLinkSelectedHint.message: Open: next · finger to the side: back · finger up 2 s: click

hudIdleHint.message: Open that hand to pick a link

aboutTagline.message: Browse the web with your hands.

aboutWhat.message: Your webcam becomes the pointer. Scroll a page, step through its links and click them with a few plain hand poses. No mouse, no keyboard, no touchscreen. Nothing to hold, nothing to aim at.

aboutWho.message: It is built first for people who cannot comfortably use a mouse: limited hand mobility, tremor, reduced strength or reach. It turns out to serve anyone whose hands are busy or far away too: a speaker driving slides from across the stage, a teacher at the whiteboard, a pair of hands covered in flour with the recipe on screen.

aboutPrivacy.message: Everything runs on your own machine. The camera image is read locally and thrown away frame by frame: no video is uploaded, recorded or sent anywhere.

permWhy.message: Gesture recognition runs in an invisible document inside the extension, and an invisible document cannot show Chrome's permission prompt. This page exists only to ask for that access one time, and after this it works on every site.

permHow.message: When you click, Chrome asks whether the extension may use the camera. Choose Allow.

permGranted.message: Camera enabled. You can close this tab and start using gestures.

permNoCamera.message: No camera found on this computer.

permBusy.message: The camera exists, but another program is using it. Close it and try again.

permBlockedBefore.message: Access is blocked for this extension. To undo it, open

permBlockedAfter.message: , find this page's address in the blocked list, remove it and come back here.

permPrivacy.message: The image is read on your own machine and thrown away frame by frame. No video is recorded, uploaded or sent anywhere.
